top3.title: Check irrigation timing: root zone past the stress point
why: [sample] Estimated depletion passed the FAO-56 stress point (p = 0.55) on 23 days.
benefits: Targets water to the days the crop is short
risks: Pumping limit under the LEMA allocation
gaps: Regional weather (~50 km) and SSURGO storage, not a probe in your field
top3.expert_check: Check with your agronomist / K-State Extension before acting.

top3.title: Consider planting date or hybrid maturity to move pollination
why: [sample] Hot days inside the pollination window above normal in 11 of 45 years.
benefits: Moves the sensitive window away from the hottest weeks
top3.expert_check: Check with your agronomist / K-State Extension before acting.

top3.title: Well cannot meet peak demand: consider fewer irrigated acres or a lower-peak crop on part of the pivot
why: [sample] Peak 7-day demand 8.1 mm/day vs well 6.5 mm/day.
benefits: Fewer days the crop runs short in July
risks: Phase-split acreage accounting is not modelled
gaps: Well capacity is from your records
top3.expert_check: Check with your agronomist / K-State Extension before acting.
